summary:
Dell is the PC maker at dell.com. The circular mark in the tab is what order-status and support bookmarks use, saved from the files that host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against dell.com. HTML came from https://www.dell.com/en-us (HTTP 200). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.dell.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 7406 bytes. Directory sizes: 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.dell.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #0077cc comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 2084 bytes) from https://www.dell.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
